hypotheses.title: Larch staging preflight requirements and service-specific verification commands
hypotheses.body: The sources indicate a shared Larch staging requirement: before applying any changes in every staging operation, inspect the complete preflight report, confirm passing results for all staged migration checks, and record the verification identifier. Production deployment is outside the scope of these staging procedures. The verification commands differ by source: alpha specifies `larch verify alpha`, beta specifies `larch verify beta`, and gamma specifies `larch verify gamma`.
limitations: Applies only to Larch staging in the supplied project scope, not production deployment.

The sources specify different verification commands without establishing whether alpha, beta, and gamma are separate service contexts or conflicting instructions for the same context; do not treat the commands as interchangeable or select one without confirming applicability.
